review_notes: Corrected: the for of the closing and for the lamps thereof was assigned to the לְ of לִמְנֹרוֹת הַכֶּסֶף (s020). וְנֵרֹתֶיהָ is coordinated under the nearer written לְ of לִמְנוֹרָה (s026), so under rule 33 that repeated preposition is s026's distributed scope, headed on its first occurrence under rule 25. The parallel first colon was already read this way, giving both for's of לִמְנֹרוֹת הַזָּהָב וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶם to s003.

Where no written preposition stands earlier in the coordination the coordinated rectum keeps its own relational word under rule 19, which is why נֵרֹתֶיהָ at s017 holds its own for while נֵרֹתֶיהָ at s029 does not.

The for's standing before מְנוֹרָה are the recast construct relation and belong to the rectum (rule 19); the distributive repetitions are rendered once, the waws and the repeated nouns unrepresented (rule 22).
